title: A star by night, Stephen said. A pillar of the cloud by day
html_source:
While wandering in the wilderness, the Israelites were led by pillars of fire and cloud.

“And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night.”
Exodus 13:21
